rows.en: That's "Mister" to you, Gomez!
There's no need for that! "Mister" for a computer? Don't make me laugh!
What are you so worked up about, Gomez?

From today on… the ones in control of you will be Professor Hustler and me! And starting right this moment!

Isn't that right, Professor Hustler?
Control? Humans, over Brain? And if I say "NO"…

Then you'll be destroyed!

TNT with a ten-stage detonation system is planted beneath this floor! What's more, I hold half the Brain Party members in my hand!

You're a computer! I doubt you need any further explanation. Answer me!
NO…
Professor Hustler, the detonator switch…
NO…
NO! NOOO!!
What do you mean, "NO"! Stop imitating Brain!
Gomez…

Heh heh heh… Gomez, you lose!

Mister Brain has disposed of every bit of the TNT.

What!?

Brain, I've lost.
Captain!!
Chief… Don't worry about me! We'll meet again…
Dr. Sahara, this is bad!! The Battleship Robot has appeared again!
What!? What's going on? Who's in the pilot's seat this time?

Gomez…?

It's Gomez!! In the Battleship Robot's pilot's seat is Captain Gomez…

What!? Gomez?

…He'll be a tough one.
[HERO2]… I want to give [HERO2] a gift too…

Listen, [HERO4]? Look around you…

I'll take the thought, thanks… Anyway, we smash these guys first!! Let's go!
[HERO2]… Will you buy me another cake?

Listen…

Can those big eyes of yours actually see what's around you? This is no time to be thinking about that kind of thing!
Our opponent is Gomez!! Let's go, One-Seven!!

Gomez… At last it's time to face One-Seven! If you win, I shall forgive all your crimes…

Gomez… Don't even think about running away!
Hmph… Just like Brain to do it this way.
Kuh… Is there no way to escape!?

Gomez! Stop this useless struggle!

If you try to escape… the TNT planted in the engine room will make a fine send-off for you!
What!?

Gomez! Stop this useless struggle!

If you try to escape… the TNT that Chief Kid planted in the engine room will make a fine send-off for you!

What!?

I see… So you betrayed me, Chief Kid!
Gomez… There is no way for you to live other than to fight One-Seven and win!
Kuh…
What's the matter, Gomez… The real contest starts now!
Grr… Battleship Robot, launch!!

Damn it… Curse you, Brain!!

If it's come to this… I'll blow myself up along with that One-Seven you built!

Is this the end…

Chief Kid! If you've got any guts… go ahead and set off the TNT you planted in this Battleship Robot!!

Look! Saburo and Rumi are coming out of One-Seven!

One-Seven's computer must have put Rumi's brainwaves back to normal…
Daaad, sis!
Rumi! Thank goodness, thank goodness you're safe…
It's all thanks to One-Seven. Thank you, One-Seven!

…………

One-Seven, thank you!
Thanks to One-Seven's efforts, Rumi was saved… The strategies of the terrifying Brain are growing ever more cruel.
Can the sorrowful steel giant One-Seven, standing against his mother Brain, stop Brain's ambitions? The battle between the Red Muffler Squad and the Brain Party continues…
Defeat all Gigants!
Confirm the Battleship Robot's pilot!
Defeat all of Kelbaan's forces and rescue Rumi Sahara!
Rescue Rumi Sahara from the Battleship Robot!
Defeat Gigant, Kelbaan's forces, the Brain Robots and the Battleship Robot!
All allies are destroyed
Saburo Minami or One-Seven is defeated, or the Battleship Robot is destroyed
Saburo Minami, One-Seven or the Sigcon Jet is defeated, or the Battleship Robot is destroyed
Saburo Minami or One-Seven is defeated
In Genmu Castle, Madou's stronghold hidden in the Genmu World, Demon King Psycho and Tactician Raider were hatching a scheme to defeat the Space Sheriffs…
Bell Helen grows more skilled by the day… Dispose of her while we still can.
I intend to, without you telling me.
Go all out!! Gaoh!
Whew, I'm tired… Let's take a little break.
What are you saying? We've only just started, haven't we?

That's right!

Didn't we decide to train with just us girls, so we wouldn't drag everyone down?
That's true, but… Lovely weather, isn't it?
Huh?
It really is lovely weather. But this peace is only on the surface, isn't it? Any time now…
Hey, how long will we keep fighting? Will there never be a day of rest for us?
Mari… What's come over you all of a sudden?

We're girls. Ordinary girls, just like you'd find anywhere.

I want to dress up! I want to go out and have fun! And yet… why, why does it have to be like this?

Mari…

All right! Let's go!
"Let's go"… where?
Shopping, an amusement park, anywhere you want to go… Everyone needs a break once in a while!
Annie, I…
Don't worry! For spending money, we'll get it from Captain Gavan… Come on, let's go!
Helen… What will you do?
I'll work up one more sweat first… I'll join you later!
OK… But don't push yourself too hard.

(I promised Sharivan! That we'd rebuild Planet Iga…

I want to make it happen as soon as possible! And for that… I have to get stronger, much stronger!)
Fightlow Soldiers!?

U07591: 債南が座行させられた read as 味方が全滅させられた.
U07594: 怯霍身 read as 南三郎 (from the parallel rows U07592/U07593).
